description: ONE-call token intelligence for trading decisions: rating (grade, 15-step grade_detail, GPA, outlook, verdict, lifecycle), per-venue grades (each with as_of, the age of its 7-day grade), unanimous-club membership, microburst quality score, warning severity/convergence, prediction hit-rate + history (history is cumulative-to-date per day; last_warning_at says when the last warning was), KG fill, 1d cross-exchange spread, open/blocked transfer routes, PLUS coverage (Coverage Grade v0: A-D score of how well NightWatch observes this asset, with per-layer L1-L8 booleans) and bti (Bot-Tradability Index v0: per-strategy verdicts ok/limited/no/unknown with reasons and limit_usd for arbitrage, momentum_swing, market_making, lending_short, plus overall t_grade). Call this FIRST before deciding what to do with a token. Requires: exchange, symbol.

exchange.description: Exchange ID (e.g. binance, upbit, gateio) or its two-letter venue code. An unknown pair answers ok:false, reason pair_not_found.
